notes: Page 2 is the generic intro page: a minifigure opens the box, sorts the bricks and starts building. It has no building step, so it adds no pieces or joins.

Step 1: Reddish Brown 4x4 plate (b1) is the base. The Dark Blue 1x4 brick (b2) goes on its back row. Two small Dark Blue 1x2 pieces (b3, b4) go in front of it. They are drawn flat, so I recorded them as 1x2 plates (lego-3023), not 1x2 bricks (lego-3004). Which of the two the manual means is uncertain.
Step 2: the White 1x4 brick with red stripes (b5) goes on the front row of b1 and rests only on b1.

Pieces are listed as parts and edges, because the output schema has no pieces/rests_on fields. Each edge runs from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v). Ports are left null because the exact stud positions can't be read from the images.

Page 4 is step 3. It builds a small sub-assembly from a Reddish Brown 1x4 plate (b8), four Dark Blue 1x1 plates (b9-b12), a Reddish Brown 1x2 plate (b13) and a Reddish Brown clip plate (b14). The sub-assembly is then placed on the model together with two Light Bluish Gray 22885 bricks (b6, b7).

The sub-assembly's internal layout is hard to read at this size, so the b8-b14 edges are my best guess. I assumed the blue plates b9-b11 sit on b8's underside and b12 goes on top of b8, and I joined b13 and b14 to each other and to b8.
The clip plate is recorded as lego-63868 (clip on end) because the icon shows the clip at the end of the plate. The catalogue also has lego-11476 (clip on side).

The placement of the sub-assembly and the two gray bricks in the final picture is approximate. I assumed b6 sits on b1 and b3 (left), b7 on b1 and b4 (right), and b8 on top of the back row. The b8-b2 edge is a guess; b8 may instead rest on b6 and b7.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v).

Page 5 is step 4. Two yellow round 2x2 bricks are stacked (b16 on b15). They go in the centre top of the model, on the gray bricks. The Dark Blue star-print 1x4 brick (b17) goes on the front face above the white striped brick.
Placement is approximate. I assumed b15 rests on b6 and b7, and b17 rests only on b5. Neither is certain from the picture.
The step does not show the star brick's other contacts, so I left them out.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v).
Page 6 is step 5. A Reddish Brown 2x4 plate (b18), two Reddish Brown 2x2 corner plates (b19, b20) and a Dark Tan 1x2 door-rail plate (b21) together cover the 4x4 top of the model.

The top layer hides the yellow round bricks. I assumed b18 covers the centre, resting on the yellow stack (b16) and the gray bricks (b6, b7). I assumed the corners b19 and b20 rest on the back brick b2 and on b6 and b7 respectively, and the door-rail plate b21 on the star brick b17.
These rests_on lists are approximate because the top view is hidden, and the earlier layout of b6, b7 and b2 was already approximate.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v).

Page 7 is step 6. A small sub-assembly is built from a Dark Blue 2x2 plate (b23), a Dark Blue 1x2 tile (b22) and a Reddish Brown clip plate (b24). I assumed the tile and the clip plate each sit on one half of the 2x2 plate's studs.

The sub-assembly attaches to the right side of the model, on the side studs of the right gray brick (b7). I assumed all four side studs are used. The mapping of b23's anti-studs to b7's side studs is a guess, since the booklet doesn't show which is which.

I used lego-11476 (clip on side) for b24. The icon shows the clip at the side of the plate, and the only lego-63868 in the set was already used as b14 on page 4. That means b14 may be misidentified, and one of b14 and b24 may be the wrong clip type.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v), except the side-stud joins, which run from the new part to the model.

Page 8 is step 7. It is the mirror image of step 6, built on the left side of the model. The sub-assembly is a Dark Blue 2x2 plate (b25), a Dark Blue 1x2 tile (b26) and a Reddish Brown clip plate (b27). It attaches to the side studs of the left gray brick (b6).
The anti-stud to side-stud mapping is a guess, as on page 7. The clip plate is lego-11476, matching b24; the set has two of them.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v), except the side-stud joins, which run from the new part to the model.

Page 9 is step 8. Six Light Bluish Gray 22885 bricks (b28-b33) form an open ring around the 4x4 top: two across the front, two across the back and one on each side. The 2x2 centre stays empty, and the side studs face outward.

Which top plates each brick sits on (b18, b19, b20, b21) is a guess, because the top plate layout is only partly visible. The ring as a whole sits on the top plates, but the individual rests_on lists are approximate.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v).
Page 10 is step 9. Two Orange 2x2 bricks are stacked (b35 on b34). A White round 2x2 plate (b36) goes on top, then a Bright Pink 2x2 brick (b37), which is the head base.

The stack goes into the open 2x2 centre of the gray ring. I assumed the lower orange brick (b34) rests on the top plates b18, b19 and b20 at the bottom of the hole. This is a guess, since the booklet doesn't show the plates under the hole.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v).
Page 11 is step 10. A second ring of six Light Bluish Gray 22885 bricks (b38-b43) goes on top of the first ring (b28-b33), with the pink brick (b37) in the open centre.
I assumed each new brick sits directly over the brick at the same position in the lower ring. The booklet doesn't show whether the ring is offset, so each brick lists a single brick below.
Edges run from the upper piece (u) to the piece it rests on (v).
Page 12 is step 11. A Dark Blue 4x4 plate (b44) caps the top of the head. I assumed it rests on all six top-ring bricks (b38-b43) and on the pink brick (b37) in the centre.

Page 13 is step 12. It adds two Dark Blue 2x3 plates (b45, b46) and a Dark Tan 1x4 plate (b47) to the side studs on the front face of the head. That face is 4 studs wide by 4 high, made of the front bricks b28 and b29 below and b38 and b39 above.
I assumed the tan plate fills the bottom row across b28 and b29. Each blue plate covers one column pair for the three rows above it: b45 on b28 and b38, and b46 on b29 and b39.
These are joins to side studs, not rests-on, so the edges run from the new part to the head bricks.

Page 14 is step 13. It adds three pieces to the front of the chest and head: a Tan 1x4 tile (b48) over the tan plate b47, a Dark Blue 1x4 plate with 2 studs (b49), and the Dark Blue 2x4 tile with the white 'A' (b50).

I assumed the 1x4 plate (b49) fills the remaining row of the front face and that both b49 and the 'A' tile (b50) clutch the two blue 2x3 plates (b45, b46). I couldn't tell whether b49 goes above or below the 'A' tile.
Edges run from the new piece to the piece it clutches.
Page 15 is step 14. Two black round eye tiles (b51, b52) go on the two studs of the Dark Blue 1x4 plate with 2 studs (b49). This confirms b49 is the eye-row plate on the front face.
Edges run from the new piece to the stud it sits on.

Page 16 is step 15. It adds five pieces to the right side face of the head: a Tan 1x2 plate (b53), a Dark Tan 1x2 tile (b54), a Dark Tan 1x1 tile (b55), a Dark Blue 1x2 tile (b56) and a Dark Blue 1x1 tile (b57). Together they form the collar and shoulder strap area.

Which piece sits on which side stud is a guess. I assumed the side bricks b31 (lower) and b41 (upper) carry them; the plate b53 is vertical and spans both. The right-side brick layout was already approximate from page 9.
All of these are joins to side studs, so the edges run from the new part to the head brick.
Page 17 is step 16. A Dark Blue 2x4 tile (b58) covers the remaining gray side studs on the right side of the head. A Tan sloped 1x2 brick (b59) goes on the tan strap plate (b53).
The tile's exact stud coverage is a guess. I assumed it joins the side bricks b31 and b41, as the right-side pieces did on page 16.
Edges run from the new part to the piece it joins.

Page 18 is step 17. The model is rotated to show the left side, and the same five pieces as on page 16 are added there: a Tan 1x2 plate (b60), a Dark Tan 1x2 tile (b61), a Dark Tan 1x1 tile (b62), a Dark Blue 1x2 tile (b63) and a Dark Blue 1x1 tile (b64). This mirrors step 15.
I assumed these attach to the left side bricks b30 (lower) and b40 (upper), mirroring the right side. The individual stud assignments are a guess, as on page 16.
Page 19 is step 18, the left-side mirror of step 16. A Dark Blue 2x4 tile (b65) covers the left side studs, and a Tan sloped 1x2 brick (b66) goes on the tan strap plate b60.
As before, I assumed the tile joins the left side bricks b30 and b40, and the slope joins b60.

Page 20 is step 19. A Dark Blue 4x4 plate (b67) covers the back face of the head, which is 4 studs wide by 4 high. I assumed it attaches to the side studs of the four back ring bricks (b32, b33, b42, b43).

Page 21 is step 20. Two Dark Blue 2x4 tiles (b68, b69) cover the studs of the back plate b67, so the back of the head is smooth. This uses the last two of the four lego-87079 tiles in the set; the other two were b58 and b65.

Page 22 is step 21. The model is turned over. A Dark Blue 2x2 plate (b70) fills the centre of the base plate b1 on the underside. The round shield (b71) clips onto the reddish brown clip plate b24 on the right arm.

I assumed the 2x2 plate attaches to the underside of b1, since the picture shows it centred on the brown base. I assumed the shield goes on b24 (the right-hand clip) because the view matches page 7's orientation. It could be b27 on the left.
The edge between b71 and b24 is not directed as a stack: the shield is a clip/bar join and can rotate.
Page 23 is step 22. Two feet are built, and each is a Dark Blue 1x2 brick pressed onto a Black 1x2 plate (b74 on b72, b75 on b73). The booklet shows this once with a 2x box.
Each foot goes on the underside of the base plate b1, so the brick studs go into b1's underside. I assumed both feet join only b1, not the 2x2 plate b70.
The b74-b72 and b75-b73 edges point from the brick down to the plate it sits on.

Page 24 is step 23. It builds the display base: a Black 4x6 plate (b76), a Black 2x4 tile with the red number 1 (b77), a Black 1x4 plate with 2 studs (b78), and a Black 1x4 tile (b79) on top of b78. The figure's feet (b72, b73) then stand on the base.
The sub-step shows a 1x4 tile being pressed onto two studs of the base. I assumed those studs belong to b78 (the plate with 2 studs). It could instead be a different plate position.
I assumed the feet b72 and b73 rest on the 4x6 plate b76. Their exact studs are not clear from the picture.
Page 26 is advertising for the BrickHeadz line (Captain America 41589 and Iron Man 41590). It has no building step, so it adds no pieces or joins.
Page 27 is advertising for the BrickHeadz line (Black Widow 41591 and The Hulk 41592). It has no building step, so it adds no pieces or joins.
Page 28 is the back cover: a product feedback prize promotion and legal text. It has no building step, so it adds no pieces or joins.

Part-count check: the build used b1 to b79. Several part types in the inventory were not placed in the pages I recorded. These include 1 Dark Blue 3022 plate 2x2 (only b23, b25 and b70 were used, which is all three), 2 Dark Blue 3023 plates and the Reddish Brown 3023 plate (b13 only covers the Reddish Brown one, if that was right). The Dark Blue 3004 bricks are used as b74 and b75. Other mismatches come from my guesses about ambiguous pieces on pages 3 and 4, such as treating the Dark Blue 1x2 pieces b3 and b4 as plates, and from which clip plate is lego-63868 and which are lego-11476.
